source_text: Proximam non diceret nisi unus spiritus fieret cum ea; speciosam nisi imaginem eius renovari de die in diem videret; columbam nisi capacem Spiritus sancti, qui in specie columbae descendit super Iesum. Cupiebat volatu celeri: Quis dabit mihi pennas sicut columbae, et volabo et requiescam?
pass_a_gloss: Near-one not he-would-say unless one spirit he-would-become with her; fair unless image her to-be-renewed from day to day he-would-see; dove unless capable of-Spirit holy, who in form of-dove descended upon Jesus. She-was-desiring by-flight swift: Who will-give to-me wings as of-dove, and I-will-fly and I-will-rest?
pass_b_english: He would not call her near unless he became [[one spirit >> Bible:1 Corinthians 6:17]] with her; fair unless he saw [[her image renewed from day to day >> Bible:2 Corinthians 4:16]]; dove unless she were capable of the Holy Spirit, who [[in the form of a dove descended upon Jesus >> Bible:Matthew 3:16]]. She longed for swift flight: [[Who will give me wings like a dove? I will fly and rest >> Bible:Psalm 55:6]].
notes: Liber IV titles of the soul.
